name: proxy
description: Encode a full-source, 720p, all-intra AV1+Opus editing proxy for instant-seek preview scrubbing. Preview-only — render never reads a proxy file. Pass tonemap for HDR sources (original, not yet conformed) to compose a scale-first HDR→SDR tonemap chain ahead of the encode; omit it for sources that are already SDR (e.g. post-normalize.py conform pass).

input.description: Source video file (any codec/color space; probed automatically)

params.name: tonemap
params.description: Source is HDR (original, not yet conformed) — compose scale-first HDR→SDR tonemap ahead of the encode

params.name: out
params.description: Output path for the proxy file
